architecture.matrix: XuanTie AME / matrix acceleration; public descriptions vary between integrated/attachable AI engines

core_scaling.note: The August LLM benchmark is described as a 64-core C950 target configuration, not a retail board or independently characterized production server.

memory.note: Alibaba publicized more than 4x memory-bandwidth improvement versus C920, but no defensible absolute capacity/bandwidth figure for the 64-core benchmark system was found.

hardware.availability_note: Announced in March 2026 as high-performance RISC-V CPU/IP for cloud, generative AI, robotics and edge designs. No public retail board/system price or broadly orderable standalone C950 server was verified.
hardware.framework_runtime_notes: Public August benchmark reporting attributes inference optimization to XuanTie SHL and dedicated MatMul/Linear, Softmax and RMSNorm kernels. This is not evidence of drop-in CUDA, ROCm, MLX, vLLM, GGUF or generic llama.cpp compatibility.

llm_suitability.model_size_practicality: Potentially relevant to 27B and much larger server-side models in sufficiently provisioned multi-core systems, but actual capacity depends on undisclosed system memory.
llm_suitability.quantization_compatibility: Not publicly specified for the August benchmark; do not infer INT4/GGUF compatibility from model size or decode rate.
llm_suitability.local_llm_assessment: Interesting RISC-V CPU-centric inference path for server/edge research, but not yet a consumer/local purchasable platform.

benchmark_evidence.note: Not independently reproduced. Quantization/precision, memory configuration, prompt/context, batch size, power and exact system implementation were not disclosed.
Target/configuration details are incomplete; this should not be compared directly with GPU or Apple Silicon benchmarks.

hardware.performance_per_watt: unknown; no defensible board/server power measurement was found
hardware.cost_efficiency: unknown; no stable public system or IP pricing was found
hardware.off_grid_suitability: unknown/low confidence; no complete-system power data or retail hardware exists for evaluation
hardware.evidence: Alibaba/DAMO announcement corroborated by Reuters and Chinese technology press; August LLM numbers are vendor-slide claims reported by independent press
open_questions: absolute memory capacity and memory bandwidth of the 64-core benchmark system
precision/quantization used for reported Qwen benchmarks
exact production SoC/server implementation and shipping status
